summary: Reject malformed email thread identifiers instead of hashing arbitrary header words into false relationships.
decision_refs: The active goal requires better RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
FR-WORKFLOW-001 permits only exact hashed Message-ID relationships
Offline reproduction linked two unrelated emails through the invalid token unavailable
approval_evidence: The persistent user goal explicitly requires continued accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Thread linkage remains exact and header-based; message bodies, dates and subjects are not used to infer relationships.
Only RFC-style angle-bracketed identifiers containing one local/domain separator are accepted; malformed or obsolete forms remain standalone.
Raw identifiers remain absent from persisted parser summaries.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer email, mailbox or provider API is used.
